newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Quake rocks Taiwan, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake rocks Taiwan, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.3 on the Richter scale struck Taiwan early on Tuesday, but there were no immediate reports of damage.

A Central Weather Bureau statement said the quake's epicentre was offshore 22.1 km (13.8 miles) due north of Taiwan's eastern coastal city of Hualien and some 28.4 km (17.8 miles) beneath the earth's surface.

The quake was felt in the capital Taipei where buildings swayed and in most parts of the island's eastern and northern region, but its highest magnitude on land was four on the Richter scale in the northeastern town of Nan-ao.
